mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ai_hr_candidate WHERE ) AS candidates, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ai_hr_matching_result r WHERE AND r.business_status='SCORED') AS scored, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ai_hr_matching_result r WHERE AND r.business_status='FILTERED') AS filtered, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ai_hr_matching_result r WHERE AND r.business_status='REVIEW_REQUIRED') AS review_required, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ai_hr_position WHERE AND status='DRAFT') AS draft_positions, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ai_hr_batch_item WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND status='NEEDS_REVIEW' AND candidate_id IN (SELECT id FROM ai_hr_candidate WHERE )) AS pending_review
